project.area: Reviewer A/B exact source inspection in Preview

nodes.goal: Read the exact approved PR source scope in one bounded attempt and record the observation in the Hub Preview journal.
inputs: Hub WorkPackage ID and canonical record version
Signed inspect-scoped grant and exact workflow digest
PR number, exact Git HEAD and complete bounded changed-file scope
outputs: Hub journal request ID and observation digest
Source-bound A handoff for separately authenticated B
acceptance: Current adoption and issuer authority match the exact Preview scope
One successful journaled attempt uses zero model tokens and modifies zero source files
evidence: Git commit SHA, A actor and execution run
Canonical WorkPackage version and immutable journal readback
allowedActions: Read exact PR metadata and scoped source bytes
Persist one bounded inspection observation using the existing Hub journal
forbiddenActions: Call a model or paid service
Self-approve independent B verification or release

nodes.goal: Use the existing independent QA path to verify the same source bytes and journal observation under B's own read-only principal.
inputs: A handoff and exact PR identity
Distinct B GitHub App installation and execution run
Same Preview runtime and canonical journal binding
outputs: Independent source digest and journal readback evidence
Explicit byte verification result and semantic review status
acceptance: B independently re-reads the pinned PR scope and checks every source hash
The current WorkPackage version, workflow digest and issuer still match
Missing B identity, signed evidence or journal access blocks the result
evidence: B installation ID and run ID
SHA-256 manifest, request ID and persisted QA readback
allowedActions: Use the existing QA Worker read-only PR and Hub journal adapters
forbiddenActions: Execute untrusted source through the Hub grant executor
Infer semantic approval from byte parity or CI
Issue a Quality Gate decision, merge or deploy
